# Abdul Habeeb

> Data Science & AI master's student at Saarland University and full-stack developer based in Saarbrücken, Germany.

Abdul Habeeb builds clear, reliable digital products and turns complex systems and datasets into tools people can understand. He works across React, Vue.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and data visualization.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio homepage](https://abdulhabeeb.com/): Profile, experience, projects, client testimonials, education, workshops, awards, volunteering, and contact information.
- [Resume (PDF)](https://abdulhabeeb.com/public/resources/Abdul_Habeeb_Resume.pdf): Abdul Habeeb's current resume.

## Projects

Each project has a detailed case study at https://abdulhabeeb.com/projects/<name>/ (challenge, solution, features, tech stack, and takeaways).


- [depower](https://depower.abdulhabeeb.com/): Daily forecast of German day-ahead electricity prices, logged before the auction closes and scored in public, with a walk-forward backtest and leakage controls. [Source](https://github.com/Habeeb9731/german-day-ahead-forecast)
- [APEX F1 Analytics](https://apex.abdulhabeeb.com/): Historical Formula 1 dashboard built on OpenF1 data, with race, telemetry, tire strategy, and championship views plus an AI race analyst. [Source](https://github.com/Habeeb9731/apex-f1-analytics)
- [Autonomous Data Analyst](https://autonomous-data-analyst.abdulhabeeb.com/): AI-assisted analytics workspace with a React frontend, deterministic FastAPI profiling engine, and Cloudflare deployment. [Source](https://github.com/Habeeb9731/autonomous-data-analyst)
- [EDEN Smart Terrarium](https://eden.abdulhabeeb.com/): Smart dual-plant terrarium dashboard (PWA) built as a group project for the Interactive Systems course at Saarland University — live sensor readings, soil trends, and pump, fan, and grow-light controls. [Source](https://github.com/Habeeb9731/eden)
- [GrandLense](https://grandlense.com): Media and photography portfolio for wedding photography, portfolio shoots, and creative services.
- [Modern Luxury Interiors](https://modernluxury-design.com/): Website for a Dubai interior design firm.
- [Ecliniqs](https://github.com/Habeeb9731/ecliniqs_deploy): Website for an online speech therapy provider based in Dubai.
- [Chick Bites Shawarma](https://github.com/Habeeb9731/food-website): Responsive website for a café specializing in shawarmas and burgers.
- MemorLoop: Desktop learning experience built around interactive flashcards and spaced repetition (UX / HCI project).
